share_estimation.issue_price: average BMNR daily close over the week (range bounds use the week's highest / lowest close)
share_estimation.purchase_price: Per week: 'disclosed' = the week's average daily ETH price × that fiscal quarter's 10-Q factor (cost of ETH purchased ÷ units ÷ purchase-weighted weekly average); 'assumed' (weeks after the last filed quarter) = weekly average × the factor pooled over all filed quarters, range ± eth_price_uncertainty. See checkpoints.json → eth_cost_quarterly and backtest.json → eth_price.
share_estimation.staking_rewards: ETH staked 4 reports earlier (min over the last 5 reports) × that week's stated 7-day BMNR yield (CESR when no Bitmine yield was stated) × days/365
share_estimation.investments_source: Disclosed cash spent on non-ETH investments in the weekly releases (Beast Industries $186M wk of Jan 25 = $180M cash + $6M costs per the 10-Q, Eightco/ORBS ~$80M wk of Mar 15, Pier Two ~$6M cash wk of Mar 29) — releases.json investments_usd.
share_estimation.staking_source: Rewards accrue only on ETH that was already staked 4 weekly reports earlier (validator entry-queue lag). Fitted to the 10-Q staking revenue: model $55.6M vs reported non-cash staking revenue $52.5M for Dec 2025–May 2026 (lag 0 gave $80.0M).
share_estimation.carry_forward_source: A week whose cash fell by less than its spending (or rose) leaves a surplus that offsets the next weeks' shortfalls, for at most 3 weeks and $5M in total (oldest used first; anything older or above the cap is dropped). Noise-sized: releases round cash to the nearest $1M and the ETH price assumption alone is ±1%.
share_estimation.eth_price_uncertainty_source: Largest quarterly deviation of the 10-Q price paid from the pooled factor (Dec–Feb −0.8%, Mar–May +0.7%), rounded up to 1%.
share_estimation.use_onchain_price_source: On-chain tracker transfers (data/onchain-purchases.json) are settlement withdrawals valued at spot by the trackers; pricing tracked weeks with them made the Dec 2025–May 2026 quarterly ETH cost less accurate than the weekly average, so they are shown as a cross-check only.

valuation.description: Valuation inputs for the Bear / Base / Bull sum-of-the-parts (SOTP). Each input has a value per case (or a "ref" to a figure the weekly build derives from Bitmine releases — see "derived") plus sources and a rationale. The page recomputes everything with the live ETH price and the current estimated share count. Edit this file to change assumptions; scripts/build-history.mjs refreshes "derived" every week.
method: Own staking (treasury) earnings = ETH held × staked share × gross staking yield × (1 − fee leakage) × live ETH price.
Corporate costs = company cash opex run-rate (excl. stock comp and one-time items) − the part attributed to serving MAVAN clients (current MAVAN client revenue × (1 − MAVAN margin)).

Treasury business value = (own staking earnings − corporate costs) × (1 − treasury tax, only if positive) × treasury multiple. Losses get no tax benefit (full valuation allowance) and are kept (costs above staking income destroy value). BMNP preferred dividends are not deducted (see preferred_treatment); they never reduce taxable income.
MAVAN third-party value = [existing client revenue × (1 − fee compression) + new client ETH AUM × network yield × take rate] × MAVAN margin × (1 − MAVAN tax, only if positive) × services multiple.
NOL tax shelter = one-off value of losses carried forward (est., pending the FY2026 10-K), added once rather than by lowering the tax rate.

SOTP per share = live NAV per share net of the $350M BMNP liquidation preference + (treasury value + MAVAN value + NOL shelter) ÷ estimated shares. Implied mNAV = SOTP ÷ NAV per share (net of preferred).
Option-premium income and interest are excluded in all cases: the ETH options program lost $133.3M in the 9 months to May 31, 2026 and cash balances (and interest) are being spent down (10-Q).
valuation.no_double_count: NAV counts ETH already held, including staking rewards already received. The earnings value capitalizes only FUTURE net staking income on today's staked base, after costs, with no growth from future ETH purchases. Each week the rewards received move into NAV while the run-rate (and its capitalized value) stays the same, so no reward is counted twice at any point in time. Because a staked-ETH ETF (e.g. BlackRock ETHB) already passes staking yield to holders at ~1.0× NAV, the multiples on Bitmine's own staking income are kept modest — the premium is only for the yield being earned at scale net of costs. The BMNP preferred is counted once: its $350M liquidation preference is deducted from NAV, so its dividends are not also subtracted from earnings (the capitalized dividend stream is the same claim — about $394M at the base 15× after 21% tax — and deducting both would count the preferred twice). Preferred dividends are never treated as tax-deductible. The rule: a perpetual preferred's claim is its dividend stream, so the SOTP deducts the $350M principal once and values earnings before preferred dividends; the weekly dividend ($646,450) still counts as a cash use in the share model.

cases.bear: Yields compress as the network stake keeps rising, part of the ETH stays with paid outside partners, costs run at the top of management's guidance, MAVAN wins no new clients and faces fee pressure, and the market pays only a protocol-token multiple.
cases.base: Today's business at its current run-rate: 13-week average Bitmine yield, staking moves toward "nearly all" ETH, 10-Q cost run-rate, MAVAN adds $1B of client assets at a typical institutional fee, and financial-sector multiples.
cases.bull: Staking near-complete with the 26-week yield (MEV upside), leaner costs, MAVAN grows client assets back to Pier Two's ~$6B at its 10% list fee, a larger one-off NOL shelter, and asset-manager multiples.

staked_share.label: ETH staked (% of ETH held)
staked_share.rationale: Bear: stays at the current share (5,227,037 of 6,051,933 ETH = 86%). Bitmine's stated goal is "staking nearly all of Bitmine's remaining unstaked ETH" (Mar 25, 2026); base 93% (half the remaining gap closed, judgment), bull 97% (keeps ~3% liquid).

gross_yield.label: Gross staking yield (APR)
gross_yield.rationale: Base/bull use Bitmine's own stated 7-day yields (13- and 26-week trailing averages, refreshed weekly). Network APR is 2.46–2.6% today with ~35% of ETH staked and a 1.3–2.1M ETH entry queue; consensus rewards scale with 1/√(total stake), so a further ~20% rise in stake cuts yields ~9% → bear 2.25%.

fee_leakage.label: Rewards paid away (advisory fee, partners, minority interest)
fee_leakage.rationale: Since Sep 4, 2026 American Validator LLC receives 1.50% of rewards on Company-staked ETH, and Ethereum Tower owns 2% of MAVAN Holdings (base/bull = 3.5%). Bear adds 5% for ETH staked with outside "staking partners" at a Lido-node-operator-like fee.

opex_usd.label: Company cash opex, annual (excl. stock comp, one-time items)
opex_usd.rationale: Base = Mar–May 2026 quarter × 4: G&A $37.27M − stock comp $13.25M + cost of sales $5.73M = $29.75M/qtr. Bear = management's 12-month cash requirements: ETH-management fees up to $50M + overhead $83.0M + working capital $12M + public-company $4M + capex $1.5M. Bull = cash G&A only ($24.02M/qtr × 4), assuming cost of sales is covered by MAVAN client revenue. Excludes $200.0M of one-time capital-raising/advisory fees (9 months).

pref_dividends_usd.label: BMNP preferred dividends, annual (reference)
pref_dividends_usd.rationale: 3.5M shares of 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred on the $100 Stated Amount ≈ $33.25M a year (10-Q). Not subtracted from earnings: the $350M liquidation preference is deducted from NAV instead, and capitalizing the dividends as well would count the same claim twice. Never a pre-tax deduction (preferred dividends are paid from after-tax income). Used only by the alternative treatment (preferred_treatment = principal_and_dividends), after tax.

tax_rate.label: Tax rate on treasury/staking earnings (if positive)
tax_rate.rationale: Staking rewards are ordinary income when received (Rev. Rul. 2023-14). Base 21% federal (Nevada has no corporate income tax); bear 23% adds some state tax; bull 15% for deductions/credits (judgment). FY2025: $0 current tax, the 20.9% effective rate was all deferred; now a full valuation allowance and no cash taxes. ETH losses (price well below Bitmine's ~$3,517 average cost) are capital losses and can't offset ordinary staking income. CAMT unlikely ($1B threshold; Notice 2025-49 excludes unrealized digital-asset gains). No tax benefit on losses.

treasury_multiple.label: Multiple on net treasury/staking earnings
treasury_multiple.rationale: Bear 6× = Lido DAO's treasury-adjusted revenue multiple (staking-protocol comp). Base 15× = money-center banks' market cap ÷ net income (balance-sheet yield businesses). Bull 18.8× = asset managers' forward P/E. Kept below asset-manager levels because staked-ETH ETFs offer the same yield at ~1.0× NAV.

mavan_existing_revenue_usd.label: MAVAN client revenue run-rate (today)
mavan_existing_revenue_usd.rationale: Pier Two (now MAVAN) contributed $3.527M of staking revenue from its Mar 24 acquisition to May 31, 2026 (68 days) → $18.9M a year. Client assets ≈ $2B (Tom Lee, May and again Oct 7, 2026) across ETH, Solana, Hyperliquid and Canton. Only named partner: Hyperion DeFi/Kinetiq's Hyperliquid validator (MAVAN 25% of commissions).

mavan_fee_compression.label: Fee compression on existing clients
mavan_fee_compression.rationale: Institutional commissions are compressing (Messari); bear cuts existing revenue by a quarter.

mavan_new_aum_usd.label: New client ETH staked via MAVAN
mavan_new_aum_usd.rationale: Disclosed client assets were flat at ~$2B from May to Oct 2026, and no new clients have been named. Bear: no growth. Base +$1B (judgment: midpoint between the flat $2B and the ~$3.9B implied by the 424B5's >$14B less Bitmine's $10.1B). Bull +$4B, back to Pier Two's ~$6B delegated assets of Dec 2025.

mavan_take_rate.label: Fee on new client rewards
mavan_take_rate.rationale: MAVAN's standard terms charge 10% of net rewards (bull). Base 8%: large institutions negotiate below list (judgment). Bear 5%: low end of the institutional 5–10% range (Messari).

mavan_margin.label: MAVAN segment operating margin
mavan_margin.rationale: Not disclosed (MAVAN is not a reported segment). Base = US asset managers' pre-tax operating margin (25.2%); bear 15% / bull 40% (judgment).

mavan_tax_rate.label: Tax rate on MAVAN earnings (if positive)
mavan_tax_rate.rationale: Pier Two, MAVAN's main business, is Australian (30% company rate); US rate is 21% plus state. Bear 30%, base 25% (mix), bull 21% (judgment).

mavan_multiple.label: Multiple on MAVAN after-tax earnings
mavan_multiple.rationale: Bear 8.5× ≈ Bitmine's ~$30.5M price for Pier Two ÷ its base-case after-tax earnings (also ≈ LDO market cap ÷ protocol revenue). Base 12× ≈ price including the full $11.8M earn-out (~$42.3M). Bull 18.8× = asset managers' forward P/E.

nol_shelter_usd.label: NOL tax shelter, one-off (est., pending FY2026 10-K)
nol_shelter_usd.rationale: Existing NOLs ≈ $50M (est.) are worth ≈ $10.5M at 21%. The rest assumes FY2026's expected operating loss adds to the NOLs (pending the 10-K, due ~Oct 30, 2026). Added once instead of lowering the rate permanently.

valuation.preferred_treatment_note: 'principal' (used): the $350M BMNP liquidation preference is deducted once, from NAV, and its dividends are not also subtracted from earnings. 'principal_and_dividends' (alternative): also subtract the dividends from after-tax treasury earnings (never before tax: preferred dividends are not deductible).
